subject: A quiet partnership idea for your coaching community
body:
Hi [First name],

I’m reaching out from VedicHour because [their work] seems aligned with reflective timing tools rather than outcome promises.

VedicHour rates all 18 planetary hours (horas) in plain English, using Swiss Ephemeris + Lahiri ayanamsa, so clients can notice clearer or heavier windows for journaling, planning, and self-reflection.

We’d be glad to set you up with a free Pro account, create a custom audience code like PARTNERNAME10, and share revenue from referred paid reports.

If useful, I can send a simple partner outline.

Your Life, Decoded Hour by Hour.

To unsubscribe, reply unsubscribe; [Physical address]
linter_reason: On-brand: focuses on reflective timing awareness, not outcomes.
